name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-ancient-cave-temple-wall
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Ancient Cave (Temple Wall)
description:
An unusual temple wall background seen in some sections of the Ancient Cave from Popful Mail for the Super Famicom. Uses only 17 tiles, meaning the user can save the rest of the space for foreground decoration.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
